paragraphs.text: 1. Old Mysore Commercial & Malting Corridor (Southern Karnataka)
Strategic Role: The undisputed production, consumption, and processing engine of finger millet in India.

Key Facilities: Large automated grain sorting, destoning, and milling facilities in Tumakuru, Doddaballapura, and Mandya; industrial malting and weaning food production centers around Bengaluru; research infrastructure at UAS Bangalore.
Catchment Areas: Tumakuru, Hassan, Mandya, Ramanagara, Bengaluru Rural, Kolar, and Chikkaballapura districts.

paragraphs.text: 2. Northwest Tamil Nadu Industrial & Extrusion Hub (Krishnagiri & Dharmapuri)

Catchment Areas: Krishnagiri, Dharmapuri, Salem, Vellore, and cross-border grain inflows from southern Karnataka.

summary.text: In Indian agricultural statistics (Directorate of Economics and Statistics / Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / ICAR-IIMR), Ragi (Eleusine coracana, Finger Millet) is classified as a premier Shree Anna (Nutri-Cereal). protection.name: Ragi Blast (Leaf, Neck & Finger Blast) (Magnaporthe grisea / Pyricularia grisea)
protection.geography: National Epidemic Hazard (Devastating across Karnataka, TN, Odisha)
protection.impact: Spindle-shaped lesions with grey centers and brown borders on leaves (Leaf Blast); dark brown-to-black necrotic lesions at the base of the earhead peduncle (Neck Blast), causing the earhead to snap and hang down; black lesions along the digitated spikes (Finger Blast), causing chaffy, empty grains and 30–80% yield collapse.
protection.passage: Ragi — source table 109, row 2. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Foot Rot / Damping-Off (Sclerotium rolfsii, Fusarium moniliforme)
protection.geography: All-India Rainfed Belts (Heavy in heavy soils and wet spells)
protection.impact: Brown, water-soaked rot at the ground collar of seedlings and young tillers; white fan-like fungal mycelium with tiny, brown, mustard-like sclerotial
protection.passage: Ragi — source table 109, row 3. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.
